treatment_group_source: data/README.md columns table: california is True for state 3 in all 31 years
treated_units_rule: california == True; per data/README.md this is state 3 in all 31 years, re-verified by src/agent_rerun/01_panel_checks.py
treatment_start_source: plan.md test 1 and data/README.md 'Treatment': Proposition 99, 25-cent per pack tax effective 1 Jan 1989. The column after_treatment marks year>=1989 for ALL states (a year dummy), so it fails the check 'zero for control units' and is NOT used as the treatment.
controls: all states in the panel except state 3 (38 states)
controls_source: plan.md 'Data': controls are the other 38 states (IDs 1, 2, 4-39)
covariates_source: none, by choice: plan.md test 1 says 'no covariates' (lnincome, beer, age15to24 are missing in many years; AGENTS.md forbids adding covariates without asking)
cluster_source: panel default: unit-level clustering; with only 1 treated unit the clustered SE is not reliable, so inference relies on the placebo test (plan.md test 3)
reference_year_source: plan.md test 2: '1988 as the reference year'
placebo_rule: assign treatment in 1989 to each of the 38 control states in turn; placebo p-value = California's rank among the 39 estimates / 39 (fixed in plan.md 'What would prove me wrong')
